source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: GREY KNIGHTS armies can withdraw eligible units as the enemy [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase) closes. Pick up to two units in Incursion, three in Strike Force or four in Onslaught. Each must be on the field, clear of enemy Engagement Range and composed entirely of models with this ability. Transfer them to [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves). They can return via an [Ingress move](vsdata:core-rule/ingress-move) during your following [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), even on your opening turn.
